description: 定位回合阶段、秘密头条、行动名额、出牌结算栈、回合末候选胜利与存档继续位置；当前是设计，不可作为已实现模块调用。 消费CT1转交/奖励计划，保留独立ChinaState并按剩余源步骤收尾。 ON1按已完成根行动槽合并已知NSO/Space总额度并绑定放弃来源集合。 LH1等待Ames选择保留已接受揭示，源/根完成与后续OPS分开。 LEO1已提交前缀保留；等待共享行动不得提前移牌或占根槽。 DV1 next-US根槽检查点与Headline分开，未定调度保持待办。 LR1在已核实ExpireAndReset边界到期，等待地区选择不提前完成根或推进普通动作。 2026-10-13用户确认的五牌边界只应用于对应参数，其他未答分支不变。 LADC1等待US回应/USSR完整目标不增根槽，事件完成不替父根执行剩余OPS。 AN1等待抽牌保留源与父帧，接受后只完成已核实根义务。 Star Wars借牌子帧由独立模块产生计划，TurnFlow保持根责任与阶段推进。
inputs: 权威状态、规则集及参数
UNPairPlan：双牌ActualUse/预算与共享根slot，保留合法UN事件证据
内部终局候选事务：先完成已接受pair牌区/当前根slot收据，再原子写Finished
陷阱新根slot资格、可信计分义务优先与内部跳过证据，不强迫普通中国牌
CT1已经验证的源牌/直系FYP父帧/根slot收尾计划；事件先于OPS时保留InResolution及RemoveAfterRemainingSteps
Wargames已验证普通根/头条的源实体和根slot清理计划；未知父义务不放行
ON1永久OPEC阻止与独立当回合US allowance；正常/NSO/当前Space名额取max而非相加，UN两实体仍一个root slot
Defectors独立双方Headline根、活动源/目标实体与接受队列；USSelected策略优先于印刷OPS排序
DV1已核实普通同回合或Headline目标根槽；FinalBoundary须末回合US最后普通来源与接受FinalScoring证据，不能清除遗漏旧待办
LR1来源完成与无等待选择的ExpireAndReset证据；已到期状态不可回退为同回合行动查询
Star Wars独立子事件计划与已接受完成收据；根责任保持不变
outputs: 权威事件；必须经过玩家视角过滤
由编排完成双牌去向/一次根slot；未知pair来源停止
已提交Finished保持吸收态，仅原CommandId收据重试/查询，不允许后置收尾变更

dependencies.relation: orchestrator consumes immutable UNPairPlan; pair service never calls TurnFlow
consume root eligibility/scoring-discard plans; trap service never calls TurnFlow

preconditions: 规则集及被触发的处理器必须齐备
版本、身份、卡牌用途、决策归属验证通过
运行实现尚不存在，本描述只用于设计检索
side_effects: 实现后会修改对局、牌区和随机状态；只能通过权威事务执行
stop_conditions: CT1终局草稿须同事务完成已接受源牌/已验证父牌及根必要收尾后写Finished；未知父链不推断
Wargames终局草稿完成接受的源牌/当前根slot收尾后提交Finished；不追加FinalScoring或回合末审计
ExpireAndReset只过期NSO回合额度，永久OPEC阻止保留；未知来源/放弃后重新开放须具名政策
被取消的计分/星号目标均Discard且无成功事实；苏方自取消保留另一头条，普通事件留存未完成父OPS
LEO1已接受前缀不能因Decline/失败选择撤销；WaitingSharedOperation保留源和根，只有核实完成回执才推进
新借牌来源按能力登记停止；不能把未支持消费者视为无合法候选

Section 10.3.2 zero draw literally follows final scoring; not a dedicated Wargames ruling. ON1: Sections 2.1.7,4.5C-D,5.2,6.4.4-5,7.3,7.5,10.3: actual control, root action rounds, source disposition, Space8 total allowance, permanent effect, blocked event and full VP batch. LEO1: Sections 5.2,6.0,7.4.1-3,8.1,8.2.5,10.3: source, actor OPS, nuclear and VP checkpoints, free-coup credit. rule_sources.description: 自己持FaceDown走奖励且不翻面为卡文直接推导；独立来源/China状态、原子计划/收据、延迟源牌去向和终局草稿为工程设计；离线模型不是真实鉴权或存档。

WG1-DERIVED-01: DEFCON 2 DeclineBoth counts as used and removes by FAQ used condition plus section 5.2, not a dedicated disposal answer. Nonzero Wargames winner follows accepted signed-VP comparison. Zero GiveSixAndEnd is now separately governed by PROJECT-WG1-USER-20261013; other source/cleanup boundaries remain. Source/receipt/atomic cleanup are planned contracts.

ON1-D01: known NSO8/Space8 combine by max, not addition, not a universal cap on future providers. ON1-D02: physical card entities and child events do not add root slots. Two durations and source-set-bound optional decline are engineering contracts; unknown later grants/repeats remain RequiresRuling.
Ames期限作用于当前手牌集合，后来同回合入手牌可见是卡文直接派生，不是专门FAQ；有限事务/来源/随机和历史收据/授权当前视图均planned。短缺及新ID重复激活RequiresRuling。

Typed priority plan, cancellation/success records, source/root cleanup and immutable historical receipts are design contracts. Unknown nested providers including Grain Sales require a separately verified contract; the FAQ timing fact alone is not authorization.

Ordered accepted prefix then optional decision; source-bound receipts and explicit shared-service handoff. Ortega named adjacency geographic waiver is a scoped derivation of the FAQ regional-action policy, not a dedicated Ortega ruling. No production operation resolution.
2026-10-13 finite prefix/checkpoint/accepted-UN/receipt contract. No official U2 repeated-use or WWBY self-activation/Trap/cross-turn timing ruling adopted.

rule_sources.edition: Named textual derivation and engineering boundaries 2026-10-13
rule_sources.description: LR1-D01: may designate permits explicit Decline; no region means no restriction instance, while the invoked optional event still completes and follows starred disposition (may + section5.2; not dedicated FAQ). LR1-D02: six primary map regions follow2.1.1; not selectable subregions. Queries return only this provider contribution, not total action legality. Repeated new event resolution remains RequiresRuling.
GiveSixAndEnd向对手完整转移6VP并结束后，恰零判Draw；不是官方专门裁定。 Verified仅表示本线程用户明确确认，非官方专门裁定；不扩大其它未答项目解释。

Optional US response derives from unless and ordinary event decision rules. Two distinct SouthAmerica targets including zero derive from the unrestricted card wording; zero doubles to zero. Private candidates, synthetic source proofs and immutable receipt continuation are engineering, not official specialized rulings. Runtime planned.

Zero selection is successful no-change event. Freshly discarded selected cards join all discards and may be redrawn. Positive draw exactly exhausting old deck reshuffles eligible current discards before source/parent cleanup, without extra draw, from R2015 4.3/4.3.1; not specialist FAQ. Locked selection and bound permutation receipts are engineering; real shuffle/RNG, authentication and durable storage remain planned.
US strictly ahead plus no legal non-scoring discard candidate: successful no-change, Star Wars Removed. HumanConfirmed project interpretation; not official specialist ruling.
Frame/entity/role/nonce/receipt/capability boundaries are engineering. Finite independent evidence anchors model trust; do not prove runtime authentication, storage or global downstream support.
